mandate: Opens the tender box on the closing day, lists offers in the Jadual Tawaran in opening order, numbers and initials each tender, enters the department estimate, signs.
notes: Two appointed Executive officers, set by policy. How they are appointed is governed by OM/KP/SP/002, which is not held here. No independence requirement is set, though in practice the two officers have come from Accounts & Finance and Group IT, deliberately outside Contract & Procurement. No quorum has been set.

mandate: Opens quotations and signs the schedule of quotations.
notes: Composition is nowhere defined. No quorum stated. RSAJ must supply both.

mandate: Gives a mandatory, non-delegable recommendation on direct-purchase appointment above RM15,000 and up to RM300,000; on open and selective appointment in the same band; and on extension of contract period for term contracts in the quotation band. The CEO approves.
notes: Membership is taken from current practice rather than policy: the evaluation approval sheet shows a Chairman, a Deputy Chairman and two members, each with named alternates. Seats are therefore held by an eligible pool rather than fixed individuals. No quorum has been set. Each member signs Setuju or Tidak Setuju with a date.

mandate: Established by the Board of Directors to approve tenders, extension of the contract period for term contracts, delay and extension of time, and variation of works. Also holds the exclusive power to decide whether a late tender may be opened and evaluated.
notes: A quorum of three members is set by policy — the only committee here with one. Membership is not: the terms of reference that would define it are not held here. In practice the board sits as five members chaired by a Director, with the CEO, COO, CFO and Head of Quality Management Division.

mandate: Mandatory, non-delegable recommendation on every variation order and every delay-and-EOT row in the tender regime, and on variations above 20% in the quotation regime.
notes: Membership is taken from practice, and two sources disagree: the work-contract procedure shows a six-member committee chaired by the COO with the CFO as deputy, while the PAAB consent form prints nine names. No quorum has been set. This committee is also recorded as approving an extension of time with no financial impact, which the authority limits reserve to the Superintending Officer — that conflict is unresolved and needs a ruling.

mandate: Decides the First Stage technical evaluation for Design & Build and Turnkey tenders — design, materials, structural, mechanical and electrical. Also approves specialist and sole-source repair methods.
notes: Membership, quorum, chair, appointment authority, output document and decision rule are all unset. This committee does not appear in the evaluation procedure flowchart at all.

mandate: Approves technical working papers and project proposals; sets scope for emergency works.
notes: A committee gate that sits outside every DAL matrix. Composition and quorum unstated.

mandate: Approves contractor loss and expense claims before the Final Account on Service contracts.
notes: Applies to Service contracts only. On Work contracts the same approval sits with the Tender Board, and for Supply contracts no approval is defined at all. No authority limit routes to this committee.

mandate: Consents to variation orders affecting PAAB-funded assets, decided AGREE or DISAGREE on form CPD/VO(CONSENT)-PAAB.
notes: External to Ranhill SAJ. Its consent is a precondition for a variation on a PAAB-funded asset, not a Ranhill SAJ approval, so it carries no authority limit of its own. Nine members are named on the consent form.
